title: GPT's metahumans
description: This mod was created for a mini youtube series where i added AI superheros into minecraft!
body:
For a youtube challenge, a while ago- i made a superhero mod using ChatGPT. I am now uploading it because i wanted to share it, if there end up being ANY updates at all. please check for a modrinth download. that's where i keep my mods up to date. 

Because thise mod was literly made by using AI to generate the concept, i don't want to claim ownership. So- anyone can use this for a youtube series, make your own version of the mod. do whatever, just link me- i really only want to be created so that people know who i am. 

anyway; what this mod adds: 

WAVE ONE:


(hero) Voltline: The speedster of the first wave, with an increase to speed and health. you can hit people with your baton, striking them with lightning. be careful because you'll hit yourself too! 

(hero) Brickstep: Stronger and larger, or smaller and weaker. Switch on and off your fist to change size or even... well yeah. change size. that's about it. lol. 

(hero) Aegis: the first girl of the group! she let's you summon an energy shield to deflect incoming attacks! 

(Villain) Hollow Veil: An evil EVIL supervillan. throw conjured knifes as Hallow veil, slight speed and strength buffs overall. 

WAVE TWO:

(hero) Vangaurd: use your baton to swing around the city, not unlike dare devil or spiderman. along with a stat boost pretty well around the board. becoming the vigilante the city needs!


(hero) Pulsewave: the second girl of our teams! she can shoot out powerful sound blasts after a short charge period! along with health and strength buffs! 


(hero) Cragheart: Become huge! and also HELLA strong! use your hammer for even more damage, as it explodes on contact! 
 

(Villain) Nullcurrent: strike lightning down on your enemies, from a distance this time! receive an overall stat boost- but best yet? if you hit someone, you can temp take away their powers! 

WAVE THREE:

(hero) Emberlash: shoot flames from your hands, burn your enemies and blaze your way to victory! a new world shall rise from your embers and LASH out! also heath and strength buffs. 

(hero) Strideiron: you have two power sets, either speedster or tank. but only one at a time. switch by holding your shield in the off hand. one is good for movement and running, the other is perfect for taking hits and prolonged combat. 

(hero) Galehorn: Our final woman in the series! GALEHORN, who has the ability to control the air! which has manifested in minecraft as having infinite wind charges and not being able to take fall damage. pairs with a mace nicely. 

(Not added yet) Gravesend: Once added, he'll have a scythe that he can use to infect anyone with poison or withering! best part is, this character is mostly my idea's and concepts. which means out of all of these, i get to keep this one. but i don't wanna. 


All armors are craftable and obtainable through simple means. most of the gear is character specific but can be used outside of that character. Enjoy!
